definitions.gloss: House of Representatives, lower house of the Japanese parliament
definitions.explanation: The lower chamber of the National Diet (parliament) of Japan. It has greater legislative power than the House of Councillors, including the ability to override the upper house and the power to choose the Prime Minister.

examples.japanese: {衆議院|しゅうぎいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解散|かいさん}→解散：04121_kaisan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The House of Representatives was dissolved.

examples.japanese: {衆議院|しゅうぎいん}{選挙|せんきょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The House of Representatives election is scheduled for next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{衆議院|しゅうぎいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{可決|かけつ}→可決：00148_kaketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{参議院|さんぎいん}→参議院：15158_sangiin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{否決|ひけつ}→否決：08396_hiketsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The bill was passed by the House of Representatives but rejected by the House of Councillors.

notes:
USAGE:
The Japanese parliament (⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧) consists of two chambers: the {衆議院|しゅうぎいん} (House of Representatives, lower house) and the ⟦{参議院|さんぎいん}→参議院：15158_sangiin⟧ (House of Councillors, upper house). The {衆議院|しゅうぎいん} has ⟦{優越|ゆうえつ}→優越：20255_yuuetsu⟧ (supremacy) in matters such as budget approval and treaty ratification. Members serve four-year terms, but the chamber can be dissolved for snap elections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衆議院|しゅうぎいん}{議員|ぎいん}: member of the House of Representatives
- {衆議院|しゅうぎいん}{選挙|せんきょ}: House of Representatives election
- {衆議院|しゅうぎいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{解散|かいさん}→解散：04121_kaisan⟧: dissolution of the House of Representatives
